stage2.text:
PLAN "Upper Body Strength for Climber with Shoulder Impingement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper-body strength for climber with shoulder impingement"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push focus":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Pull focus":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Mixed/Accessory":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 3m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3m
    WEEK 2:
